nodes.label:
Complaint or
Conflict Reported
nodes.title: Complaint or Conflict Reported
nodes.info: Any mentor, student, or parent can report a concern to the club leader or assistant leader.

nodes.label:
Club Leader Documents
the Report
nodes.title: Club Leader Documents the Report
nodes.info: Date, people involved, and a factual description are written down within 24 hours, before memory fades.

nodes.label:
Does This Involve
Safety or Harassment?
nodes.title: Does This Involve Safety or Harassment?
nodes.info: Safety and anti-harassment-policy violations always escalate immediately; ordinary disagreements do not.

nodes.label:
Escalate to Venue and,
If Needed, Authorities
nodes.title: Escalate to Venue and, If Needed, Authorities
nodes.info: The venue's own safety contact is notified the same day; law enforcement is contacted immediately for any safety emergency.

nodes.label:
Club Leader Mediates
a Conversation
nodes.title: Club Leader Mediates a Conversation
nodes.info: Both parties are heard separately first, then, if appropriate, brought together with a mentor present.

nodes.label:
Outcome Is Documented and
Shared With Involved Families
nodes.title: Outcome Is Documented and Shared With Involved Families
nodes.info: Families receive a summary of the resolution appropriate to what they need to know, respecting other students' privacy.

nodes.label:
Entry Added to the
Lessons Learned Log
nodes.title: Entry Added to the Lessons Learned Log
nodes.info: Recurring conflict types get flagged so the club can adjust its code of conduct or session structure, echoing Chapter 1's continuous improvement cycle.
